name: Pentabromobenzyl bromide
description: Pentabromobenzyl bromide (CAS 38521-51-6 ) is a highly brominated aromatic compound used as a reactive and additive flame retardant in polymer and textile systems. Its high bromine content makes it effective at suppressing ignition and slowing flame propagation in demanding industrial applications. In plastics and polymer compounding, it is incorporated into engineering resins and thermosets to meet stringent flammability standards such as UL 94 V-0. Textile back-coating formulations use it to impart durable flame retardancy to upholstery and technical fabrics. The compound provides protection to curtains and technical fabrics without significantly compromising substrate flexibility. In leather and paper processing, it functions as a flame-retardant additive where surface treatments or impregnation processes require halogenated chemistry. It is also evaluated as a reactive intermediate for synthesizing brominated flame-retardant compounds used in specialty polymer systems. This versatility makes it a critical component for manufacturers seeking high-performance safety solutions in chemical manufacturing. Pentabromobenzyl bromide is supplied as a solid, typically in powder or crystalline form. It is available in technical grade, with purity specifications commonly confirmed by bromine content assay and melting point range to ensure consistent performance. Packaging is offered in multi-kilogram quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes.
